description: Issue the single bundled attested execution receipt inside an open Position Lifecycle (purchased with position_lifecycle_begin). The receipt fields are the same execution_receipt takes: the pre-trade fields the agent gated on plus the settlement txHash. Covered by the lifecycle purchase — no per-call charge — but the single bundled credit is consumed on success; a failed issuance never consumes it. Authenticates with the one-time lifecycle token.

receipt.description: The same pre-trade + settlement fields execution_receipt takes

name: position_lifecycle_receipt
